work_unit.title: 校验版本模型与提示词执行快照
work_unit.goal: 确保 HostTrusted compatibility execution 的 runtime、model 和 prompt 与 AgentVersion 固定事实一致。

reason: Production preflight showed the native Run binds AgentVersion but the heartbeat adapter reads mutable compatibility Agent config; without an equality gate, a recorded version can differ from executed model or prompt.

rules: Fail before heartbeat dispatch on snapshot mismatch.
Do not mutate compatibility Agent configuration from the background runner.
Use the existing codex_local adapter identifier in the publishing UI.
